architecture_units.name: unsloth (core library)
architecture_units.resp: Public API (FastLanguageModel/FastModel), import-time backend selection, model patchers, manual kernels, optimizers, registry.

architecture_units.name: unsloth_cli (CLI)
architecture_units.resp: Typer console app exposing start/train/chat/inference/export/studio; subagent (Claude/Codex) MCP integration.

architecture_units.name: studio (desktop app)
architecture_units.resp: Tauri desktop app: Rust backend (src-tauri) + TS frontend + Python backend; model run/train UI, data recipes, MCP server.

architecture_units.name: unsloth_zoo (external dependency, NOT in this repo)
architecture_units.resp: Shared heavy machinery: training_utils, vision_utils, tiled_mlp, model_lists, dtype utils, MLX modules, vendored flash-linear-attention.

architecture_units.name: tests / scripts
architecture_units.resp: pytest suites (python/sh/qlora/saving/security/studio), CI supply-chain audit, lint, notebook validation.
